sources.entry: AiPPT - Simplifies design with automatic outlines. #free

summary.name: AiPPT
summary.one_liner: AiPPT is an AI presentation creator that turns topics, documents, URLs, and notes into editable PowerPoint-style slides.
use_cases: Turning a PDF or Word document into editable slides
Generating a pitch deck from a business idea
Converting a research paper into a presentation
Creating slides from a web page URL
Drafting a presentation outline from a topic
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an AI tool that generates presentations from a topic, pasted markdown, uploaded PDFs, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images, or URLs, producing structured outlines and slide layouts. Users can edit slides through natural-language instructions such as rewriting text, inserting charts, or changing themes. It offers template libraries across business, education, research, and marketing categories. It also states it can export finished decks to PPTX, PDF, or images and share them via link, and that it integrates image models (Flux, Imagen, Seedream, Nano Banana) and video workflows (Kling, Vidu).
notable: Converts PDFs, Word, Excel, images, and URLs into editable slides
Natural-language editing of slides, layouts, charts, and themes
Integrates Flux, Imagen, Seedream, Nano Banana image models and Kling/Vidu video workflows
Large template library including education and lesson-plan categories
caveats: Pricing details are not stated on the page; a Pricing section is linked but its contents were not provided
Some animation and video features are described only as available in some workflows
